entries.en: Y-You want to know what I do? But my name─I thought it was obv─ahem. Very well. What I do is quite simple: I take any of the materials you've collected on the island, and sell them for cowries on your behalf. Don't worry, I <italic(1)>never<italic(0)> take anything for myself. Trust me.

entries.fr: Vous pouvez m'échanger les matériaux récupérés sur l'île contre des assignats insulaires et je me chargerai de les exporter<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
やぁ、ぼくはかいとりさん！
島で採れたいろんな物資を買い取って、
シェルダレースクリップとの交換をしているよ！

entries.en: Sell materials in your isleventory to the enterprising exporter in exchange for islander's cowries.
entries.fr: Les assignats insulaires émeraude s'obtiennent en échangeant vos biens insulaires à Laracheteuse, à la hutte placide.
entries.ja:
「かいとりさん」では、
「シェルダレースクリップ:緑島貨」で、
無人島内で集めた物資を買い取ってもらえます。

entries.en: In addition, the enterprising exporter may be willing to part with seafarer's cowries in exchange for uncommon materials in your isleventory.
entries.fr: Certains matériaux de valeur peuvent lui être échangés contre des assignats insulaires azur.
entries.ja:
また、一部の貴重な素材は、
「シェルダレースクリップ:青船貨」で、
直接買い取ってもらえます。

entries.en: Why, hello there, friend of the owner! (Pssst, just between you and me, I might have a little something for you...if you've got the cowries.) \<bleep> Oh, I didn't see you there, felicitous! Don't you worry, I'm just conversing with this lovely individual here. (Nosy cat bastard...)
